fica.src: SSA 2026 wage base; 6.2% OASDI to the base + 1.45% Medicare uncapped

brs_match.src: 5 U.S.C. 8440e(e)(3); 5 CFR 1600.19 — automatic 1% from 60 days, match from 2 yrs + 1 day, both end at 26 YOS

tsp_limits.src: IRC 402(g)/415(c); IRS Notice 2025-67, TSP Bulletin 25-3; SECURE 2.0 s603

bas_meal.src: OUSD(C) Food Service Charges memo eff. 2026-01-01 — discount rate B $3.35 / L $5.55 / D $4.75 = $13.65; charged to ESM/EUM members (DoDD 1418.05, JTR 020315)

fsa.src: 37 U.S.C. 427 as amended by the FY2026 NDAA — $300/mo eff. 2026-01-01 (was $250 since 2003); prorated $10/day; payable after more than 30 continuous days

hfp_idp.src: 37 U.S.C. 310; DoD FMR Vol 7A Ch 10 — HFP $225 for any month with exposure, IDP prorated at $7.50/day

hdp_l.src: 37 U.S.C. 352; DoD FMR Vol 7A Ch 17 — $50/$100/$150 by designated location

afrh.src: 24 U.S.C. 419 — $0.50/mo from enlisted, warrant, and limited-duty officers of the Armed Forces Retirement Home services; Coast Guard is not assessed

tdp.src: TRICARE Dental Program premiums eff. 2026-03-01 through 2027-02-28 (United Concordia; tricare.mil/costs) — by sponsor grade, one family member vs two or more; paid by payroll allotment a month ahead. Active-duty families pay NO enrollment fee for TRICARE Prime or Select.

fsgli.src: VA Insurance Service FSGLI premium table eff. 2025-07-01 ($0.40–$4.00 per $10,000 by spouse age); children $10,000 at no cost

cz.officer_cap_note: Officers exclude up to the senior-enlisted (E-9 max) monthly basic pay plus HFP/IDP; enlisted and warrant exclude all pay earned in the zone
cz.src: 26 U.S.C. 112; 26 CFR 1.112-1; DoD FMR Vol 7A Ch 44

dla.src: PDTATAC UTD/MAP 72-25(I), CY2026 DLA rates eff. 2026-01-01 (JTR 0505); partial DLA per military.com CY2026 table

tle.src: JTR 0506, Tables 5-13/5-17; MAP 66-24(R) raised CONUS TLE from 14 to 21 days eff. 2024-11-27; $290/day cap

tla.src: JTR 0507 (TLA) — locality per diem × family-size percentage; no daily cap; 60 days on arrival, 10 on departure, in 15-day increments

ppm.src: JTR 051502 — 100% of the Government Constructed Cost for moves after 2025-09-30 (the 130% authority expired); advance up to 60%; DFAS withholds 22% federal on the taxable excess of incentive over receipted expenses

leave.src: 10 U.S.C. 701 — 2.5 days per month; carryover above 60 days is lost at fiscal year end unless SLA applies; 60 days of leave may be sold in a career, at basic pay only

retirement.src: 10 U.S.C. 1401/1407/1409 — 2.5% (High-3) or 2.0% (BRS) per year of service × high-36 average basic pay; retired pay from the first day after 20 years, no age gate

per_diem_ie.src: JTR 020304-F — incidental expense $5 CONUS; $3.50 OCONUS when lodged in government quarters on a U.S. installation; none under field conditions or aboard ship

sdp.src: 10 U.S.C. 1035; DoD FMR Vol 7A Ch 51 — Savings Deposit Program: 10% a year, compounded quarterly, on up to $10,000, after 30 consecutive days in a designated combat zone/direct-support area drawing HFP/IDP; interest runs 90 days past return and is taxable

idp_rules.src: DoD FMR Vol 7A Ch 10 ¶2.2 (Oct 2024) — IDP prorated $7.50/day to $225; the 31st is never a paid day for members on active duty 30+ days; HFP is the full $225 for any month with a certified hostile-fire event

hdpl_rules.src: DoD FMR Vol 7A Ch 17 ¶2.1.4, ¶3.1 (Dec 2024) — TDY/deployed HDP-L starts on the 31st consecutive day, retroactive to arrival; maximum $100 in any month HFP/IDP is paid; HDP-L + HFP/IDP ≤ $325

deploy_zones.src: IDP: DoD FMR Vol 7A Ch 10 Table 10-1 (incl. Red Sea/Gulf of Aden/Bab-al-Mandeb Oct 2023, Gaza/Israel seas Mar 2023, Ukraine Apr 2022). CZ: IRS Pub 3 (2025) / FMR Ch 44; EO 12744, 13239, 13119; P.L. 115-97 §11026. HDP-L: DFAS HDP-L table updated 2025-09-23 (Kuwait $100 from Sep 2025).
